notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Strangleroot Geist.
Strangleroot Geist dies, triggering its undying ability and Blood Artist.
Resolve the Strangleroot Geist trigger, returning it to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing target player to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature you don't control.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Young Wolf.
Young Wolf dies, triggering its undying ability and Blood Artist.
Resolve the Young Wolf trigger, returning it to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing target player to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Strangleroot Geist.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Strangleroot Geist.
Strangleroot Geist dies, triggering its undying ability and Blood Artist.
Resolve the Strangleroot Geist trigger, returning it to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing target player to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Young Wolf.
Repeat from step 6.
